title: Distance from the Truth: Why Fragmented Merchant Underwriting Misses Risk, and What Source-Attributable Evidence Changes
abstract: arXiv:2611.34696v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Merchant underwriting becomes vulnerable when evidence is evaluated without enough visibility into its source, freshness, relationship to the applicant, or meaning for the proposed activity. Individually favorable checks do not necessarily establish that the same business is operating the merchant account, that its representative may bind it, or that its settlement instructions are authorized. We describe three failure modes of fragmented underwriting: distance from the source, the gap between a decision and the evidence needed to justify it; the correlation gap, in which material relationships among the person, legal entity, owners or controllers, representative, business activity, and settlement destination are not evaluated when each signal is considered alone; and point-in-time controls, in which a historical verification is treated as present eligibility. translated_title: 《与真相的距离：为什么碎片化的商户核保会遗漏风险，以及可溯源证据能改变什么》
translated_abstract: 当评估证据时缺乏对其来源、时效性、与申请人的关联性以及其对拟开展业务意义的充分了解，商户核保就会变得脆弱。各项核查单独来看均无问题，并不必然证明是同一企业在运营该商户账户、其代表有权对该企业产生约束力，或其结算指令已获得授权。我们描述了碎片化核保的三种失效模式：来源距离，即决策与支撑该决策所需证据之间的鸿沟；关联缺口，即当每个信号被单独考量时，个人、法人实体、所有者或控制人、代表、业务活动与结算目的地之间的重要关联关系未被评估；以及时点控制，即将历史上的验证视为当下的适格性。我们将这些失效模式映射到身份核验、客户尽职调查、制裁筛查等领域（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文指出碎片化商户核保因“来源距离、关联缺口、时点控制”三种失效模式而遗漏风险，并提出以可溯源证据来弥补这些缺陷。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies three failure modes of fragmented merchant underwriting—distance from the source, the correlation gap, and point-in-time controls—and shows how source-attributable evidence closes these risk gaps.
